a novel surfactant mixture of SLG and alkylphenols ethoxylates was developed to emulsify the fluorinated polyacrylic latex, and the resultant latex has excellent water resistance and thermal stability.

the preparation and characterization of fluorine-containing polymer latex, the novel fluorine-containing polymer is prepared with the semi-continuous seeded emulsion polymerized method and the latex is emulsified with mixed surfactants.
the preparation of fluorinated latex with novel mixed surfactant system and the results show the potential application of the novel fluorinated latex in water-based coatings.

the novel fluorinated latex prepared with the novel mixed emulsifier is a promising candidate for the water-borne coating.

we have prepared a novel fluorinated poly(acrylic acid) latex with the novel mixed emulsifiers of SLG and OP-10 and the novel fluorinated monomer of HFMA.
